benchmark.name: ConStellaration P2: simple-to-build QI stellarator
benchmark.candidate_contract: A Python solve(fm, rng) optimizer returns a stellarator boundary; clean-room evaluation re-scores the boundary.
benchmark.official_score: objective_L / 20 when every normalized violation is <= 0.01; otherwise 0
benchmark.search_score: official P2 when feasible, otherwise negative worst normalized violation; later campaigns also apply margin and novelty shaping
benchmark.fidelity_warning: Very-low-, low-, and official-fidelity objective values are not interchangeable. Official confirmation is required for score claims.

latest_persisted_state.summary: The latest approach is feasibility-first repair of self-generated or imported scientific-database seeds with the public leaderboard bank disabled. It is not an unaided construction arm and has not produced an officially feasible boundary.

live_runtime_observation.caveat: The live process and image show that historical missing-image errors are not a verified present blocker. The persisted factory state nevertheless has not advanced since 2026-08-28; process liveness alone does not prove scientific progress.

seed_factory.last_persisted_attempt_failure: Docker image evoharness-stellar-eval unavailable; pull access denied
seed_factory.caveat: The best 0.1205 attempt persists in state.json but was not saved by the factory's L >= 12 save rule after the platform changed to the low-L repair boundary.

host_steward.behavior: It retries the repair loop every 15 minutes and periodically retries the factory; the persisted frontier remains repair round 694 / factory round 2421 even though a factory process is currently present.
host_steward.operational_assessment: supervision active; persisted frontier stale; current process progress unresolved

highest_raw_official_in_legacy_ledgers.evidence_grade: legacy official single-shot; boundary persisted in run_end, but the path predates the full evaluator fingerprint required by the newer research harness

run_families.caveat: Repeated continuations share ancestors; counts are event/run counts, not independent trials. Run-end private evaluation can execute a stochastic optimizer again and can differ sharply from train/val.

run_families.conclusion: NAE/ellipse starts did not approach the 0.01 feasibility gate.

Single-stage warm evaluation reduced cost, while true hot restart changed equilibria and was rejected. Soft-fail grading recovered signal from some nonconvergence but did not create structural novelty.
Null and underpowered at n=2; it tested an aspect-only boundary gradient, not the solver objective/QI gradient. Writers used 0.002-0.004 caps, about 100x beyond the later measured trust region.

A real local improvement that transferred across fidelity and ended in trust-region collapse. The project contains competing causal diagnoses: QI projection, search-only margin shaping, and a later relaxed-margin ceiling result that disputes the shaping explanation. It is evidence for local polishing and an observed stall, not for a settled stall mechanism or basin discovery.
Activating new high-order modes exploited coarse resolution; the large VLF gains reversed at official fidelity.
NAE, ellipse, and NAE-axis constructors remained catastrophic or nonconvergent; none reached the LF promotion corridor.

The multi-agent harness improved claim checking, provenance, and experiment selection but produced no physics candidate or score. Its strongest scientific diagnosis was the independent arm's edge-mirror transfer wall.

plot_series.notes: Series are grouped by comparable experiment family. Do not connect unaided construction, imported-database repair, and inherited public-seed refinement into one trajectory.

database_repair_acceptance_milestones.lineage_warning: Accepted milestones can switch among imported/self-generated seeds and are not one boundary lineage.

feedback_lessons.worked: Provides the actual competition objective after clean-room official evaluation.
feedback_lessons.failed: Rewards consuming the full 1% feasibility tolerance and made a near-copy look better than the public leader.
feedback_lessons.fix: Track honest score, raw score, feasibility, bank distance, and bank cosine together.

feedback_lessons.worked: Recorded repeated dead ends and implementation hazards across runs.
feedback_lessons.failed: Pages can lag newer persistent runs, and shared reviews can interleave; the current index still foregrounds the older 0.6400 result.
feedback_lessons.fix: Treat memory as hypotheses and navigation; recompute claims from run artifacts.

feedback_lessons.worked: Pinned-solver FD gradients produced a small official local gain at caps around 3e-5.
feedback_lessons.failed: Aspect-only tools, large caps, solver-version sidecars, and gradients used as structural search all failed or optimized the wrong surface.
feedback_lessons.fix: Use gradients as a local operator with re-linearization and official transfer checks, while structural search supplies new basins.

feedback_lessons.worked: Preserved alternative behavior cells and made provenance explicit.
feedback_lessons.failed: On stellarator runs they frequently returned the resumed seed or an inherited stochastic private boundary; they did not solve candidate generation.
feedback_lessons.fix: Measure generation-vs-selection gaps and require independent construction plus fidelity promotion.

feedback_lessons.worked: Made proposed mechanisms falsifiable and preserved why a candidate was tried.
feedback_lessons.failed: Confident predictions were often wrong, and repeated API/audit failures consumed evaluations.
feedback_lessons.fix: Score calibration and protocol compliance separately from physical outcome.

claim_policy.historical_score_claim: State provenance, fidelity, feasibility, tolerance use, novelty metrics, and evaluator-fingerprint status.
claim_policy.independence_claim: Distinguish unaided NAE/ellipse, scientific-database repair, self-generated repair, and public-leaderboard inheritance.
claim_policy.latest_claim: The latest persisted database-repair artifact is infeasible at VLF with 0.04070 worst violation. It uses imported scientific configurations/self-generated seeds and is neither unaided nor a public-leaderboard refinement. No unaided or database-repair arm has an official positive P2 score.
claim_policy.novelty_claim: bank_dist >= 0.001 alone is insufficient; cosine 0.999998-0.99999 demonstrates near-copy structure.
claim_policy.completion_claim: A run is complete only with a terminal event/report or explicit halt reason. The host steward's repeated relaunch log does not mean useful work is active.
